value: The restored weapon returns to Dalaran by faction-specific roads. An Alliance seeker reports through Caladis and the Silver Covenant; a Horde seeker through Myralion and the Sunreavers. In the blood-elf sword branch, Aethas publicly presents the new bearer. Other characters unable to wield the sword receive a different weapon type. These are alternative game outcomes, not one champion’s combined history, and no named adventurer is made the canonical heir.
editorNote: Original paraphrase for research status. Check quest sequence, faction branch and setting against the original 3.3.5a client before lore approval. Randomized gameplay or mutually exclusive branches do not assert a unique canonical adventurer.
